walk.png.source: generated with Codex CLI's built-in image generation, 2026-09-27, from a picture of the postman, then one edit pass (flat background, the last pose corrected), then the legs of drawings 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8 sheared by hand below the hip so the planted foot moves back evenly
walk.png.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Generate one production 2D animation sprite sheet using the attached image as CHARACTER AND WOODCUT STYLE REFERENCE, not as a layout reference.
Output walk.png concept: exactly EIGHT full-body images of the SAME short young postman, strictly facing RIGHT in profile, ONE horizontal row. Wide canvas requested 3072 x 1024 or wider. Divide composition into 8 equal invisible cells, center each figure in its cell, with ample blank space between figures. Entire bodies, hats, hands and shoes visible. No overlap.
Match reference faithfully: nineteenth-century hand-colored woodcut, dark irregular ink contours, textured navy uniform and large navy peaked cap with black visor and gold badge, small boyish rosy-cheeked face, brown hair, white collar, black tie, three brass buttons, navy trousers, black shoes, red leather mailbag behind left hip and red diagonal shoulder strap. Same face, cap, bag, outfit and character scale in all 8 poses.
Walk cycle left to right: 1 contact, near leg forward heel on ground and far leg backward toe on ground; 2 down/recoil, front knee bent accepting weight and rear heel lifting; 3 passing, planted near leg under body and far bent leg passing it; 4 up, planted near leg extended and far knee forward; 5 opposite contact, far leg forward heel on ground near leg backward; 6 opposite down; 7 opposite passing; 8 opposite up. Arms counter-swing to legs and clearly alternate. Feet follow plausible walking arcs; each stance foot meets identical ground baseline. Same top-of-cap height and overall scale across frames, keep torso motion subtle inside this registration.
Background absolutely flat solid ivory #efe6d2, including all margins, no texture on background, no gradients, no floor, no cast shadows. Textured printing only inside figures. No text, numbers, grid lines, cell borders, watermarks or additional objects. Exact 8 figures, evenly spaced in ONE row, head tops aligned and ground contact baseline aligned.

Edit pass:
Edit the FIRST input sprite sheet. SECOND input is only character scale/height reference. Preserve exactly eight full-body right-facing postmen in one row, same character identity, costumes, head tops aligned, evenly centered in eight equal invisible cells. Correct the walking cycle with distinct successive phases: contact, down, passing, up, opposite contact, opposite down, opposite passing, opposite up. Particularly the LAST eighth pose MUST be an UP pose with a bent knee lifted forward and opposite stance leg extended, NOT a wide contact stride. Keep hands counter-swinging to legs.
Change the background to EXACT flat uniform #efe6d2 RGB239,230,210. Remove ALL background paper grain, gradients and mottling. Keep woodcut texture INSIDE the character silhouettes only. This is a game sprite atlas on a flat solid color, NOT a photograph of paper.
Keep 2048x688 wide canvas. Align cap top around y64, soles of ground-contact feet at y628, matching character pixel height of second input wave sheet. Eight equal 256px-wide cells. Fit each complete silhouette comfortably within its cell, visible gaps, no overlap. Same hat/head/body proportions and scale every frame. Preserve all eight characters and style. No text, numbers, shadows, borders or grid lines.

wave.png.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a 2D animation sprite sheet, EXACTLY SIX full-body right-profile copies of the reference postman in ONE horizontal row. First input is the original character design reference. Second input is a scale and style reference from his walk sheet. Match that rendered character height and look. Canvas 2048 x 688 pixels, six equal invisible cells with centers at x=171,512,853,1195,1536,1877. Cap tops at approximately y=114 and shoe soles y=570. Character height approximately 456 px. Plenty of blank space between silhouettes, no overlap, no clipped hands or shoes.
Same small young nineteenth century postman, navy peaked cap gold badge black visor, brown hair rosy round cheek small face, navy uniform white collar black tie brass buttons, navy pants black shoes, red mailbag behind hip with red diagonal strap. All frames show strictly right-facing head and body, same face clothing bag proportions scale and cap height. Vintage hand-colored woodcut outlines and print texture INSIDE character ONLY.
Wave animation in exact order left to right: 1 standing still with near arm down hand by thigh; 2 near arm raised halfway, elbow bent hand at chest height; 3 near hand raised in front of face with OPEN palm and five natural fingers; 4 same raised OPEN palm swung outward away from face toward right; 5 same raised OPEN palm swung inward toward face toward left; 6 near arm lowered halfway to chest height. Far arm remains down, feet together planted in identical position and same sole baseline in every frame. Only near arm gestures, torso and head remain still. Hand does not obscure face.
Absolutely FLAT UNIFORM SOLID background exact RGB (239,230,210), hex #efe6d2, across whole canvas including gaps, no paper grain, mottling, vignette or color variation on background. No shadows, ground, text, labels, numbers, grid lines, dividers or watermarks. Exactly 6 evenly spaced full bodies, one row.

Edit pass:
Edit this waving sprite sheet. Preserve EXACTLY SIX figures and their six hand gesture poses in one row: down, half up, open hand in front of face, open hand outward, open hand inward, half down. Same right-facing postman identity, navy cap/uniform, red bag, woodcut textures and outlines inside figures. Two precise changes:
1) Replace entire backdrop with perfectly flat SOLID COLOR #efe6d2 RGB(239,230,210). No paper texture, no gradient, no vignette or noise whatsoever in empty space. Flat computer color as sprite-sheet background.
2) Reduce ALL SIX characters UNIFORMLY to approximately 460 pixels in height on a 2048 by 688 canvas. All six cap tops on y114, all six shoe soles on y576. Keep aspect ratio natural. Leave generous empty space above and below. Center figures within equal-width cells of 341.33 pixels each. Scale ALL figures equally. No gridlines. Preserve full bodies, all feet and hand gestures visible, no overlaps, no shadows, no writing.
